sections.title: About Me
content: I am Md Khaja Eshaq, a Computer Science and Engineering student passionate about Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Computer Vision. As a Media Cell Coordinator and NEC Member, I combine technical expertise with leadership and collaboration.

I enjoy building AI-powered applications, training machine learning models, solving algorithmic challenges, and deploying scalable software solutions. My goal is to leverage AI to solve real-world problems and continuously grow as an AI/ML Engineer.
